description: Wedderburn-strata enumeration for H_n(R, q) at q = q_0 ≈ 1.109979. For each n, lists every partition λ ⊢ n with depth, classical and q-deformed dimensions, signed content (chirality marker), the canonical Plancherel weight w_λ = (dim_classical)²/n! (q-independent, sums to exactly 1), and the q-deformed alternative dim_q²/[n]_q! recorded as `q_deformed_weight` (does NOT sum to 1 at finite q ≠ 1). Strata are grouped by curvature-rank depth = height(λ) - 1.
